name: Metal License Plate Frame
description:
Premium Material:
  • Crafted from high-quality aluminum, this Metal License Plate Frame is lightweight yet durable for long-lasting use. 
  • The sturdy metal construction is resistant to bending, rust, fading, and daily wear, making it suitable for all weather conditions. 
  • Its smooth surface and polished edges provide a sleek and modern appearance for your vehicle.

 

Sizes & Dimensions:
  • Frame Size: 12.21 in (31 cm) x 6.3 in (16 cm)
  • Designed to fit most standard US license plates

 

Printing Technology:

The design is printed using advanced UV printing technology, delivering vibrant colors, sharp details, and long-lasting durability. The high-quality print resists fading, peeling, and scratches, ensuring your personalized artwork stays vivid over time.

 

Functionality Use:
  • This license plate frame helps protect your license plate edges while adding a stylish and personalized touch to your vehicle. 
  • The durable aluminum material offers waterproof and rustproof performance, while the internal buckle structure keeps the frame securely in place. 
  • Perfect for cars, trucks, SUVs, or decorative automotive displays.

 

Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
  • A personalized Metal License Plate Frame makes a meaningful gift for family members, friends, car enthusiasts, veterans, or patriotic celebrations. 
  • Ideal for birthdays, anniversaries, Father’s Day, Mother’s Day, Christmas, Independence Day, housewarming parties, or any special occasion.

 

Specification:
  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
